name: Shio
message: 「Gasp!? How long have you been standing there!?」

name: Shio
message: 「You say you were captivated by the sight of my training!?」

name: Shio
message: 「N-No, such praise... Compared to my seniors, I still have a long way to go...」

name: Shio
message: 「So, what business brings you here today」

name: Shio
message: 「C-Could it be! You went out of your way to deliver a birthday present for me!?」

name: Shio
message: 「I shall treasure it as a family heirloom!」
